hero.title: From prototype to product, live.
hero.lede: Four ways to work with Corvus Web Studio: web products and SaaS, games and interactive experiences, AI integration, components and design systems. One point of contact, from scoping to production.

web.title: Web development & SaaS products
web.text: Web apps, back offices and SaaS, from the data model to the interface. Nine years of product work in teams: ad tech, sports, creator tools.
web.proof: Done before. A campaign module handling over a million euros, and a multi-repo to monorepo migration led end to end.
web.d1: Fullstack Next.js / React application, production ready
web.d2: API and database: Node, NestJS, PostgreSQL, MongoDB
web.d3: Authentication, Stripe payments, deployment on Vercel or AWS
web.d4: Taking over and modernising an existing codebase

games.title: Games & interactive web experiences
games.text: Multiplayer browser games, branded mini-games, interactive experiences: real time, canvas, animation. Nothing to install, on desktop and mobile alike.
games.proof: Done before. Three released games, designed and built solo: One Piexel, Iconic and Fastr.
games.d2: Real-time multiplayer: WebSocket or peer to peer
games.d3: Canvas engine, sprite and animation integration

ai.title: AI integration
ai.text: Plugging AI in where it serves the product: MCP servers, Skills, agents and content generation. With guardrails, evaluations and cost tracking.
ai.proof: Done before. GPT-4 built into TweetHunter: tweet completion, correction and optimisation. An agentic workflow used every day.
ai.d1: MCP servers: exposing tools and data to an assistant
ai.d2: Skills and agentic workflows for a team
ai.d3: AI generation built into the product (text, image)

components.title: Components & design systems
components.text: Polished, accessible, documented React components. Micro-interactions, animations, themes: a design system a team can pick up without a spoken manual.
components.proof: Done before. The Nest demos, with copyable code under the MIT licence. This site is one of them.

s1.title: First contact
s1.text: One message is enough. A first conversation to pin down the need, the constraints and the deadline.

s2.title: Scoping & quote
s2.text: Scope, milestones and a detailed quote. Nothing starts without a written agreement.

s3.title: Build
s3.text: Short iterations, a demo at every milestone, access to the repository and to a test environment.

s4.title: Delivery & follow-up
s4.text: Production release, documentation and handover. Maintenance available afterwards, on quote.

fixed.title: Fixed-price project
fixed.text: A defined scope, a price set per milestone. Suited to a website, a game, an MVP or a well-bounded AI integration.

team.title: Team reinforcement
team.text: A Senior Fullstack engineer embedded in a product team, full time or part time, for an agreed period.

short.title: Prototype or audit
short.text: A short format to validate an idea, audit an existing codebase or assess an AI integration lead.

contact.title: A project in mind?
contact.text: A few lines describing the need are enough to get started. Reply within 24 h.
